Question:
Use `faker_qa/misc_password_random_index_while_loop_iterations/files/testcase.py`, class `TestMiscPasswordRandomIndexWhileLoopIterationsQA`, method `test_misc_password_random_index_while_loop_iterations_case`. That dispatches through the proxy to `faker.providers.misc.Provider.password` (localized subclasses share the same implementation in `faker/providers/misc/__init__.py`). In that function, consider the loop `while len(random_indexes) < len(required_tokens):` at line `205` whose body is line `206` (`random_indexes.add(self.generator.random.randint(0, len(chars) - 1))`). Duplicate index draws do not grow the set, so the loop may execute more than `len(required_tokens)` times. How many times does line `206` execute during this test run in the **top-level** invocation of `password` (i.e., not counting any nested or unrelated calls)?
